name: autumn-street-red-sweater-bouquet

prompt.project_info: Create a natural romantic city-street editorial portrait of an approved adult woman holding a bouquet beside an ornate architectural doorway.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with dark wavy hair, natural glam makeup, and a soft thoughtful side gaze. She wears a red knit sweater, white layered lace mini skirt, sheer tights, black shoulder bag, and delicate earrings. One hand touches her hair while the other supports a bouquet of red roses and white lilies wrapped in warm paper.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 medium-full portrait with subject and bouquet sharp, standing before a textured stone facade and decorative dark wooden/metal door. Preserve the exact pose, bouquet placement, bag, and architectural symmetry.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daylight from the side with gentle facade bounce, balanced highlights, realistic lace and knit texture, warm romantic city-street atmosphere, subtle film grain.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm portrait lens aesthetic, moderate shallow depth of field, natural crisp focus, realistic skin, flowers, paper, lace, and stone texture, 4:5 vertical.
